sections.h2: You have a quality offer, but your *revenue isn't keeping up?*
sections.lead: Most growing businesses have good ideas and a quality product or service… yet they still hit the glass ceiling:
pains: Visitors land on their site, but leave without taking action
A message that feels vague or too complex to an outsider
A customer journey that creates friction
Customers who don't bring in enough to be truly profitable
The frustrating gap between the real quality of their service and how it's perceived

reveal.h3: The problem is the *friction points* in your customer journeys
p: The reality… is that you don't need complex marketing tactics, an end-to-end automated tech stack, or more engaged customers. Adding complexity on top of an already irritating foundation only speeds up failure.

The real obstacle is friction: the difficulty of articulating the value of your offer persuasively and turning it into a customer experience that flows like a water slide. Because when the message doesn't land or the path is complicated, the money stays in your customers' pockets.

sections.h2: Meet the founders of Viesigners: Canada's #1 web micro-agency for *making your business profitable*
sections.sub: Charles-Erick & Jean-François BG — Masters of web experience design (2009)
text: **Hi! This is The BG Twins.** We are hybrid experts in web experience design, UX/UI and conversion rate optimization (CRO) — originally from Québec, Canada — with more than 30 combined years helping companies of all sizes and sectors, in English- and French-speaking markets, perform online.

**A unique approach that unites customer experience and web business strategy.** Surrounded by a network of select digital experts, as human as they are skilled, we act as business advisors, strategic consultants, senior freelancers and delivery partners in designing offers and digital experiences, in order to:
checks: **Improve landing pages and sales journeys** to increase inquiries, appointments and calls
**Clarify and craft compelling offers** that immediately prompt customers to act
**Simplify onboarding and the experience** of apps and services to increase loyalty and extend customer lifetime

items.name: Elodie Marcotte
items.title: Charles-Érick’s support went far beyond my expectations

Creative, quick-witted and incredibly well organized, he goes well beyond simple user experience thinking. He is a deeply human person, and it shows directly in his work. I recommend him with my eyes closed.

items.name: Marie-Eve Gratton
items.title: A true reference when it comes to web strategy and UX design
items.text: What can I say about Charles-Érick… a truly one-of-a-kind human. His great strength is his ability to take his clients and colleagues to another level through his strategic thinking and his fine understanding of UX. It’s also a real pleasure to collaborate with him and to bring visually to life the ideas we develop together. I recommend him without hesitation!

items.title: Innovative, creative solutions that always demonstrate added value
items.text: Charles-Erick was a key person on the various mandates, always bringing innovative, creative solutions while demonstrating added value. Always looking for the best solution to meet user needs, his thinking was always in-depth, methodical and based on exhaustive research. Whether in brainstorming to support a strategic plan, creating UX mockups, A/B tests or user journeys, his work made it possible to create creative solutions for our team, while being highly effective for clients and O2. Charles-Érick is an excellent team player, always very invested in his work, and his presence at client meetings was greatly appreciated. It was a real pleasure to work and brainstorm with Charles-Érick on various strategic projects for clients or to help the Agency evolve.

items.title: A genuine idea machine

He supported us on several projects, and we notably collaborated with him on Flokon’s user interface analysis, customer journey optimization and website sales funnel optimization.

He is a humane, multidisciplinary, creative person who can think differently. He is extremely pleasant to work with and always knows how to adapt to our needs.

items.name: Tom Pigott

items.text: Jean-Francois has been an incredible collaborator on a SaaS project that I have been focused on over the past several years. His unique insight and experience into what makes great UX/UI, how to A/B test all aspect of our landing page, fine tuning our lead gen funnel, etc., have all contributed greatly to the success we are enjoying today. I highly recommend Jean-Francois and his agency!

items.name: Simon Bouchard
items.title: An approach that’s both strategic and very concrete, focused on measurable results
items.text:
I’ve had the opportunity to collaborate with Charles-Erick on several occasions and I highly recommend him.

He is a CRO and UX expert with a great ability to quickly grasp the issues and identify where a business is losing conversion opportunities. His approach is both strategic and very concrete, focused on measurable results.

What especially sets him apart is his structured approach. He doesn’t work on intuition or by trial and error. He formulates hypotheses, tests them and validates them with concrete data, which leads to real, lasting improvements.

He doesn’t just give theoretical advice. He offers clear, actionable avenues adapted to real-world conditions.

If you truly want to improve your web performance, your conversion or the clarity of your offer, he is definitely someone to talk to.

items.name: Miguel Duarte
items.title: One of the most professional and detail-oriented UX designers I’ve come across
items.text:
I’ve worked with Jean-François on a SaaS project, and I can honestly say he’s one of the most professional and detail-oriented UX designers I’ve come across. What really sets him apart is his communication. He has a rare ability to tailor his delivery depending on who he’s talking to, whether it’s a developer, a business stakeholder, or anyone else on the team. Everyone walks away with clarity.

His grasp of the entire user journey goes far beyond surface-level design. He doesn’t just polish interfaces, he digs into root causes, questions assumptions, and crafts UX-driven solutions that address the real problems underneath. That kind of thinking elevates the whole project, not just the design layer. He’s also incredibly reliable and easy to work with. Deadlines are met, feedback loops are tight, and there’s never any ambiguity about where things stand. He brings a genuine passion for the work that’s contagious, the kind of energy that raises the bar for everyone involved.

If you get the chance to work with Jean-François, take it. He’s the kind of professional that makes you feel like your project is in good hands from day one.

sections.h2: What we're trying to say is: it's time to hit the *go button!*
sections.p: The accelerator pedal for growing businesses.

a: Viesigners is a Canadian web micro-agency based in Québec and Vancouver, founded by Charles-Erick and Jean-François BG. We specialize in UX/UI and conversion rate optimization (CRO): websites, landing pages, sales funnels, SaaS and mobile app product design, and business advisory.
With our network of experts, we also support clients in digital advertising, social media and SEO/GEO.

faq.q: What does a digital agency actually do?
a: A digital agency weaves invisible links between brands and minds. It codes emotions. It designs stories that interest, explain and motivate action.

At least, that's what we strive to do every day: build high-performing digital ecosystems — sites, apps, campaigns and content that propel brands toward more visibility, engagement and measurable growth.

faq.q: What are the advantages of a micro-agency like yours?
a: First, we don't know of any web agency that, like us, makes it a point of honor to deliver top 3% worldwide quality without handing you off to an inexperienced employee or making you feel like a number, as you often see in larger agencies.
We believe that's why a growing number of our clients set aside budgets originally planned for other experts: we deliver on our promises and focus all of our actions on your ROI.

faq.q: How can I be sure I'll get my money's worth?
a: Every service we offer comes with a guarantee that other agencies don't dare to offer. [Contact us](@contact) to learn the details.

faq.q: Do you work with large or small companies?
a: We serve startups and SMBs as well as large corporations. The main criterion is that you must want to grow.
If you feel a service could help you, [contact us](@contact) and we'll assess how best to support your goals, either in-house or through our limited network of selected experts.

faq.q: Which languages and markets do you work in?
a: We work in French and English, with clients in Québec, across Canada and in more than 6 countries. Our offices are in Québec and Vancouver, and we collaborate remotely with teams around the world.
